record.headline: Intercom raised the Essential list price from $19 to $29 per seat per month and now offers new customers a 35% discount that brings it back to $19.
record.who: New customers see the discounted $19; existing customers and anyone not eligible for the promotion face the $29 list price.
record.read: The effective entry price for new buyers is unchanged, so the move shifts cost mainly onto non-promotional and existing seats. The back-and-forth between $19 and $29 suggests Intercom is still searching for its Essential price point.
record.caveat: Essential has flipped between $19 and $29 several times in recent weeks, and PricingSaaS headlines elsewhere describe the $19 seat price as one arm of a live pricing test, so this may be an experiment rather than a settled change.
